sentences.text:
By this writ petition, the petitioner prays for a  direction upon the concerned respondents to pay compensation in respect of 0.98 acres out of 1.80 acres of a plot of land being no. 1351(LR)
appertaining to Mouza - Harisara, J.L. no. 1, L.R. Khatian no. 261, P.S. Mayureswar, District Birbhum at present market rate.
sentences._hearing_file: Sanjib Baul vs Union Of India & Ors on 14 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The capsulated form of the facts projected in writ petition are the petitioner's grandfather acquired the land by virtue of a registered deed of sale executed in 1954.
sentences._hearing_file: Sanjib Baul vs Union Of India & Ors on 14 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: In a land acquisition proceedings being case no. 12 of 1964-65 initiated under the Land Acquisition Act of 1894 (Act-I of 1894), an area comprising 0.82 acres of the aforesaid plot of land was acquired by the concerned respondents.
sentences._hearing_file: Sanjib Baul vs Union Of India & Ors on 14 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Subsequent thereto, by a notification vide. no. 14456 L.A./IR-6/64 dated 23rd August, 1966 issued by the Deputy Secretary, Government of West Bengal, the aforesaid plot of land being C.S. Plot No.
1351 was released from the acquisition proceedings.
sentences._hearing_file: Sanjib Baul vs Union Of India & Ors on 14 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Suffice it to observe that in the LR record of rights also, the plot was numbered as 1351.
sentences._hearing_file: Sanjib Baul vs Union Of India & Ors on 14 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The petitioner claims that suddenly on the basis of the work order issued by the Railway Authority on 30th October, 2012, the concerned contractor in favour of which the work order was issued started construction of level crossing and other works and while carrying out the aforesaid work,
0.98 acres of the land has been utilized.

sentences.text: Mr. Chatterjee, learned counsel appearing for the Union of India submits, upon instruction, that the Joint Survey was held but the report of such Joint Survey has not been made available to the Railway Authority and Union of India.
sentences._hearing_file: Sanjib Baul vs Union Of India & Ors on 14 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Hence, he is not in a position to apprise the Court of the latest position of the land in question.
sentences._hearing_file: Sanjib Baul vs Union Of India & Ors on 14 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
On 3rd May, 2023 when the matter was taken up for hearing the State remained unrepresented and,
hence, the Court requested Mr. Dey, learned A.G.P. to appear in this matter to represent the State along with the learned advocate, Mr. Anirudha Mohanta.
On 30th November, 2023 the writ petitioner was directed to serve a notice upon Mr. Dey, learned A.G.P. giving an intimation that the matter will be taken up on 13th December, 2023.
Today, when the matter was taken up for hearing, none appears to represent the State.
In view thereof, list the matter for further consideration on 10th January, 2024 at 2 p.m. L.A.
Collector, Birbhum is directed to depute one official who is acquainted with the facts and circumstances of the case to remain present in the Court at the time of hearing of the writ petition with all the relevant records and the Joint Survey report to enable the Court to decide the issue or issues raised in the writ petition.
The petitioner is directed to communicate this order to the L.A. Collector along with the server copy of this order and L.A. Collector is directed to act on the basis of such communication.
sentences._hearing_file: Sanjib Baul vs Union Of India & Ors on 14 December, 2023.json

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
In this writ petition, the petitioner claims that a portion of his land has been utilized by the railway authority and hence, he prays for compensation in respect of that portion of the land, so utilized and as an alternative prayer, he seeks release of that land in his favour.
A coordinate Bench of this Court by passing an order dated December 8, 2022 directed both the railway authority concerned and the Land Acquisition Collector, Birbhum to hold a joint survey.
Pursuant thereto, the L.A. Officer, Birbhum is present but he is not in a position to state clearly whether the joint survey was held in terms of the order dated December 8, 2022.
None is present to represent the State although this Court by passing an order 14.1`2.2023 indicated that presence of the State representative is very much required to give judicial answer to the query raised in this writ petition.
opennyai_summary.issue: To decide the issue involved in the writ petition, the Court wanted to ascertain whether the petitioner's land or any portion of his land was acquired by the Land Acquisition Collector on the basis of the requisition made by the railway authority.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Mr. Samanta is requested to represent the State and to avail necessary instruction.
Let his appointment be regularized.
It is clarified that if it is found that if such joint survey was held, L.A. Collector, Birbhum submit joint survey report on the returnable date but if no joint survey was held in terms of the order dated December 8, 2022, the railway authority and the L.A. Collector, Birbhum are directed to hold joint survey within three weeks from date.

If it is found that any portion of the petitioner's land has been utilized by the railway authority,
demarcation shall be made to locate such portion of the land and after completion of joint survey,
L.A. Collector, Birbhum shall submit the joint survey report on the returnable date.
List this matter for further consideration on February 13, 2024.
